content: STAGE 1 — orientation. Goal: understand the SID-table/reference data layout and prior metric implementations before proposing. Read: listing of the agent working directory. Observed: beginning exploration. Reasoning: a proposal must be implementable from the exact exported arrays; I want to see hbaa code and the 97-pair manifest if present. Still open: which arrays exist (item codes per level, source/target reps, training histories) and their dimensions.

STAGE 2 — FINAL ANSWER: hyp_horosphere_bucket_lift. Construction: hyperbolic Karcher barycentre m_k of each level-1 bucket's frozen source reps, and u_h of each training history; boundary direction xi_h=u_h/||u_h||; Busemann/horosphere height y_k(h)=log((1-||m_k||^2)/||m_k-xi_h||^2); standardise y over all K buckets per history; metric = mean_h tanh(z_{b(i+)}). Uses SID level-1 codes + frozen per-item source reps + training histories only, no val/test. Curvature c=1 enters in the Poincare Frechet means and the horosphere/Busemann function (no Euclidean analogue). Differs from HBAA: horospherical asymptotic height, full bucket barycentre, full K-1 negative-bucket distribution, within-history standardisation, collapse returns 0. Compute O(|H|*K*d), |H|<=2048, <1 min. Worst on K=1, random relabel, all bucket barycentres on one horosphere. Full formatted answer in the response.
